content_of_post_to_comment: I want to know what completely random thing you know WAY too much about. Not your job. Not your degree. The thing you could give an entire presentation about that nobody ever asked for. I LOVE this kind of stuff.
comment: I suspect the most revealing rabbit holes are the ones that start with a tiny question and end with an entire mental archive. There's a difference between knowing random facts and knowing the history behind why something is the way it is.
